items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller, Rags

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.

Measure vibrations level 
 for bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and 
 determine what to do.

Check discharge quantity 
 and pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- 
 out components.

Check alignment and 
 compare it with the setting value.

Measure vibrations level 
 for bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and 
 determine what to do (if it is needed).

Check discharge pressure 
 and compare it with the setting value then replace the worn- out components 
 (if it is needed).

Check bolts fixation, 
 then re-tight it (if it is needed).

Make test for bearings 
 grease and add or change it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking 
 and replace it if it is needed.

Check flanges for 
 leaking.

Check the pump casing 
 against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
